item.title: Multiclass Image Classification using Transfer Learning
item.description:
Project Description

I built a multiclass image classifier on top of InceptionResNetV2. Rather than training a large network from scratch, I started from a pre-trained model and reused what it had already learned, then trained it to recognize my own set of classes.

Project Highlights

  • Used InceptionResNetV2 as the base model and adapted it to the target classes through transfer learning.
  • Added data augmentation and input normalization so the model would do better on images it had not seen during training.
  • Wrote the full training and evaluation pipeline in Python.

Technical Skills Acquired

  • Python
  • Deep Learning
  • Transfer Learning
  • Computer Vision
  • Data Augmentation
